position_sizing.conditional_logic: Lot = initLotSize * MathPow(multiplier, currentPositionCount). First entry uses initLotSize. Subsequent layers multiply by inMultiply for each additional position. Validated against broker lot min/max/step/limit and free margin.

custom_logic_notes: Two signal modes selectable via input: (1) eTypeCrossMA - simple MA crossover using current bar [0] vs previous bar [1] comparison; (2) eTypeTrend - MA trend + candle direction + Stochastic confirmation, all using previous completed bar [1]. Grid/martingale layer system: additional positions opened only when price moves against existing position by inJarakLayer pips (200). Buy layers triggered when ASK drops below (lowestBuyPrice - JarakLayer*Point); Sell layers triggered when BID rises above (highestSellPrice + JarakLayer*Point). Dynamic BEP-based TP/SL recalculated every tick across all layered positions. Lot validation includes broker lot min/max/step/limit and free margin check via OrderCalcMargin. Bug: In CrossMA signal mode, CopyBuffer uses index [0] (current forming bar) for crossover detection which can repaint; in Trend mode, correctly uses index [1] (completed bar). Another bug: getTotalVolume() line 329 uses PositionGetDouble instead of OrderGetDouble when iterating pending orders.
python_conversion_notes: Martingale lot sizing with exponential escalation is high-risk and broker-dependent (lot step, min, max, margin). Grid layer spacing logic requires position tracking with price-level awareness. Dynamic BEP-based TP/SL recalculation must run on every tick. The margin check via OrderCalcMargin has no direct Python equivalent - would need broker API margin calculation. JarakLayer uses Point() which requires proper pip/digit normalization for 5-digit brokers. Signal mode 1 (CrossMA) reads current bar [0] which causes repainting - Python version should use previous bar [1] for both modes.
